reel.caption:
Is a bigger hospital room worth it if your policy has a room-rent cap?

Many health policies cap the daily room rent, often at 1% of the sum insured.
Pick a room above the cap and the insurer pays the same ratio of room-linked charges (doctor, nursing, procedure), not just the rent gap.
Illustrative: ₹5,000 cap, ₹10,000 room = 50%. On ₹1 lakh of room-linked charges, ₹50,000 can come from your pocket.
Under the 2024 insurance regulator master circular, medicines, consumables, implants, diagnostics and ICU charges aren't cut by this ratio.

Sources: a personal-finance magazine's explainer (Sept 2026) and an insurance advisory's guide on proportionate deduction.
